tweet.text: We estimate that Claude Sonnet 4.5 has a 50%-time-horizon of around 1 hr 53 min (95% confidence interval of 50 to 235 minutes) on our agentic multi-step software engineering tasks. This estimate is lower than the current highest time-horizon point estimate of around 2 hr 15 min.
